description: This Java class 'NotificationsCleanUpService' handles scheduled cleanup of notification request data and database partitions related to notifications, including tenant-specific cleanup logic and system tenant handling.

classes.name: NotificationsCleanUpService
classes.description: A service class responsible for scheduled cleanup of notification requests and database partitions related to notifications, with tenant-specific logic.

methods.name: cleanUp
methods.description: Scheduled method that performs cleanup of notification data and partitions based on TTL and configuration.

methods.name: cleanUpNotificationRequests
methods.description: Performs cleanup of notification requests older than a specified expiration time, handling system tenant and tenant-specific requests.

methods.name: cleanUpByTenant
methods.description: Removes notification requests for a specific tenant in batches until all eligible requests are deleted.
